name: Example: start two jobs when done
description: A quick morning check of splunkd's own health. When it succeeds it starts two other examples, Example: hourly splunkd errors and Example: top sourcetypes to a lookup, each as its own run. Adding this example also adds those two, so the Start job actions have something to start.

steps.name: splunkd warnings in the last hour
steps.spl:
index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd log_level=WARN
| stats count BY component
| sort - count
